target_customer: Developers and engineering teams who want serverless cost and speed benefits without rewriting existing code; no paying customers found
problem: Moving existing applications to serverless usually requires rewrites; Sunpia generates a microservice version from annotated code that deploys on the customer's own cloud.
business_model: Developer tools, pricing not stated; the site shows a waitlist call to action

founders.name: Alan Pham
education: UC Berkeley, Bachelor's and Master's in EECS
founders.background_notes: YC page: research in speech, systems and machine learning.

founders.name: Ivy Pham
founders.background_notes: YC page: professional experience in product management and business analytics; employers not listed.

founders.name: Vikranth Srivatsa
founders.background_notes: YC page: systems and machine learning research including the UC Berkeley SKY Lab.

competitors.name: Serverless Cloud (Serverless Inc.)
competitors.what: Serverless platform; said it was building toward deploying to Kubernetes and other clouds without code rewrites
competitors.traction_then: Launched on Product Hunt in March 2022; ran on AWS only at launch

technical_complexity.rationale: Automatically decomposing arbitrary annotated code into deployable microservices requires program analysis and systems research; the founders come from Berkeley systems research.

defensibility.rationale: Code transformation technology is hard to copy quickly, but cloud vendors and serverless frameworks can add similar tooling.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copy was found in sources; no traction signal was found either.

market_need_then: Serverless adoption was growing and Berkeley researchers had published on serverless computing, but no contemporaneous customer demand evidence was found for Sunpia specifically.

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or review evidence about the brand; similar trademark names exist for unrelated firms.

outcome_analysis: Sunpia is listed active by YC with three founders from Berkeley research backgrounds, but no priced product, customers or outside round were found and the site still shows a waitlist. The status is unclear stall rather than a documented failure, and no cause can be stated from public sources.
notes: Funding: CB Insights shows a 500K convertible note dated 2022-09-07 with Y Combinator, which matches YC's standard deal, so no round is recorded; Extruct shows 125K (aggregator, unverified). No press coverage of any raise found. Founder education comes from the YC page. Round Funded page is a reconstruction and was ignored. Outcome search found no shutdown, pivot or acquisition news; later status is unknown. Completeness pass: one round recorded from CB Insights (convertible note, 500K USD, 2022-09-07, Y Combinator), which matches the YC standard deal.
